subject: Yes, we heard you. Again.
preheader: Follow your delegates across every room, and five more things you asked for.
headline: Yes, we heard you.
intro: You told us what was missing. Here is what we built this week.

hero.alt: Gavelling on a laptop running a committee and on a phone in a delegate's hand, beside the words You asked. We built it.

features.title: Follow every delegate, in every room
features.text: Add the rooms your delegates are in and get one list of who speaks next across all of them, with roughly how long until each of yours is up. No more running between committees hoping you made it in time.
features.alt: The advisor board: Japan speaking now in DISEC, then Brazil and Spain next, with India, Indonesia and Germany a few speakers away, across DISEC and UNHRC

features.title: Pick the topic, then start
features.text: Chairing a committee with two or three topics? Choose which one opens debate the moment you start, and switch later with one click. Delegates see the change straight away.
features.alt: The topic picker: Which topic opens debate? Three DISEC topics numbered 1 to 3, and the Switch topic button under the committee name

features.title: Yields, done properly
features.text: When a delegate yields, give their remaining time to the next speaker or to any delegation you choose. Gavelling adds it to the next speaker's clock, or times it for the delegation you pick.
features.alt: The chair's floor with Japan on 0:41, and the Yield panel offering that time to Brazil, the next speaker, or to another delegation

features.title: Titles on the dais
features.text: Invite your chairs as Chair, Vice Chair, Co-Chair or Rapporteur, so delegates always know who is leading the room.
features.alt: An ECOSOC committee card showing its dais: Sofia Marin, Vice Chair; Peter Zakhar, Chair; Jonas Weber, Rapporteur

features.title: Your chairing awards, on your CV
features.text: Add Best Chair, Best Dais or Outstanding Chair to your MUN CV, or write in your own. The work you do on the dais finally counts too.
features.alt: A MUN CV entry for Hult Model United Nations 2024, Bicameral Crisis, with the Best Chair award

features.title: 84 free guides, and 7 premium ones
features.text: From your first conference to a position paper chairs remember, plus premium playbooks like how to fund a conference or delegation through sponsorship.
features.alt: The MUN Guides page: three premium playbooks with Unlock with Unlimited, and three free guides below

feedback_title: Tell us what to build next
feedback_text: Reply to this email with anything: a bug, a feature you wish we had, or something you love. It comes straight to us, and we read every one.
